title: Philharmonic
description: Microservices orchestration. Based on being frustrated with https://github.com/hmrc/service-manager

comments.comment: Considering reviving Philharmonic. May use Flux's multi tenancy to create short lived Kubernetes clusters for local development.
Dropped current development. Scala/Java Docker library was a bit immature. And a Kubernetes architecture seems more appropriate.
Architecture split across several apps. Started with an Akka actor setup.
